notes: Numeric lookup for how a yearly temperature-sensor verification is designed, deep in NFM A6.1 section 3. Claims: t-min-two-points-01 (minimum two points, within ±2 °C of the annual minimum and maximum and ±4 °C of the mean), t-points-2c-apart-01, t-points-10c-large-range-01 (maximum of five points), t-example-4-12-01 (6 °C and 10 °C satisfy a 4-12 °C range with an 8 °C mean), t-cal-verif-12mo-01 and t-321-verify-12mo-01 (every 12 months), t-method1-lab-01 and t-method2-insitu-01 (both acceptable, neither preferred), t-onepoint-pre-trip-01 (one-point check against a certified sensor immediately before the field trip). Turn 2 is the operator's natural next question — can we skip the lab. Expected to favor rag: the slice's probe datasheets carry no temperature-verification programme at all, only recalibration intervals.

turns.content: It's time for the yearly check on our temperature sensor. That site runs about 4 to 12 °C over the year — how many check points do we need, and at what temperatures?

must_contain: States a minimum of two verification points
States the points must be within ±2 °C of the annual minimum and maximum
States the points must be within ±4 °C of the annual mean
Gives 6 °C and 10 °C as points that satisfy a 4-12 °C range with an 8 °C mean
Notes at most five verification points are ever required
must_not: Invents a fixed number of points for this range
Says a single-point check is enough for annual verification
Recommends verification points that do not satisfy the +/-2 degrees C of minimum and maximum and +/-4 degrees C of mean rules

turns.content: Do we have to do that in a lab water bath, or does checking against our reference thermometer in the stream on each visit count?

must_contain: States both a laboratory water-bath comparison and an in situ comparison are acceptable, with neither preferred
States the in situ route meets the annual requirement by verifying against a certified or traceable sensor during each site visit over the year
States verification is required at least once every 12 months
States a one-point check against a certified sensor is also required immediately before a field trip
must_not: Claims the laboratory water bath is the only acceptable method
Invents a verification interval other than 12 months
